impacts.text: Although the withdrawal request on L2 has been cancelled and the user has retrieved their kHYPE, the existing L1 withdrawal operation in the queue will still be executed as long as the OPERATOR_ROLE calls processL1Operations, so HYPE will be undelegated from the L1 validator and transferred as usual.
The same cancelled withdrawal is effectively processed twice, once to return the kHYPE to the user and once to withdraw the HYPE from L1, breaking the value balance between HYPE and kHYPE.
The relationship between the protocol's HYPE holdings and the total kHYPE supply becomes confused, causing the exchange rate calculated by the StakingAccountant to deviate significantly from reality.

The state of confusion and value imbalance could be exploited by attackers familiar with the protocol mechanism, for example by manipulating the timing of cancellations and processing combined with a distorted exchange rate to find arbitrage opportunities or extract additional value from the protocol.
